d: Haryana Steelers reigned supreme over Gujarat Giants by a 35-22 scoreline in Match 40 of the Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Vinay outshined the opponents by scoring 9 points, while Sanjay led the team’s defence with 4 tackle points.
